clock_convention: Clock labels from the original stage-19 analysis; no timezone conversion.

left_panels.source: Supplied monitoring figure; plot data are embedded as a raster, with a separately drawn scan cursor. Native data found locally were not substituted because they did not reproduce this figure.
left_panels.pumping: The pumping panel is also embedded from the approved monitoring figure. The packaged CSV is supporting source context, not substituted into the displayed figure.
left_panels.annotation_cleanup: monitoring-clean.png is the built-in imagegen annotation-removal output chosen by the user. It is a visual source figure, not recovered raw measurement data. The three reference PNGs are retained unchanged.

before_hit.selected_series: Liu et al. (red triangles in supplied chart)
before_hit.timestamp_basis: Original pre-hit notebook: monitoring start 08:17:51 + 8 min, 30-second increments. The separately assembled pumping subplot in the supplied figure is not used to stretch these timestamps.

after_hit.source: Curves and shaded intervals digitized from supplied after-hit PNG. This is a raster-derived display approximation, not new inversion data or a confidence-interval interpretation.
after_hit.timestamp_basis: Least-squares affine mapping from the five visible clock tick positions on the supplied figure, 09:31 through 10:51. Do not stretch to the longer legacy NPY inversion time range. X sampling is for animation, not a claim about the original inversion sampling interval.
after_hit.pixel_quantization: About 0.0064 mm in width and 1.28 m in height; time alignment approximately 10 seconds per pixel. Isolated missing line pixels at intersections are interpolated from visible neighbours.

transition: Compress approximately 09:03 to 09:18 into a 600 ms eased scan and fade between right-panel layouts. No intermediate notice, pause or added inversion values; not an inferred exact fracture-hit time.
